body:
## Summary

Closes #25 — mobile-first overhaul of the meta-sovereign SPA shell, the connections flow, and the in-app tutorial. The work is broken into six atomic commits mapped to twelve stable requirements `R-N1` … `R-N12` (see [`docs/REQUIREMENTS.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/REQUIREMENTS.md) section U).

| Requirement                                                              | Where it lives                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **R-N1** Compact bottom-nav at ≤640 px with 44 × 44 px tap targets       | `js/src/web/shell/app-shell.js`, `js/src/web/app.css`                       |
| **R-N2** Navigation rail at 641-1023 px                                  | `js/src/web/shell/app-shell.js`                                             |
| **R-N3** Permanent drawer at ≥1024 px                                    | `js/src/web/shell/app-shell.js`                                             |
| **R-N4** Per-provider Connections module (one card per provider)         | `js/src/web/connections/index.js`                                           |
| **R-N5** Translated connection state badges (`Not connected`, `Probing`) | `js/src/web/connections/`, locales                                          |
| **R-N6** Setup-step list shipped per provider                            | `js/src/web/connection-guides.js` exporting `setupSteps[]`                  |
| **R-N7** Probe button surfaces translated outcome                        | `js/src/web/connections/`                                                   |
| **R-N8** Provider detail view reuses the per-provider guide              | `js/src/web/connections/detail.js`                                          |
| **R-N9** Tutorial step anchors a translucent spotlight to a real control | `js/src/web/tutorial.js` (`TutorialSpotlight`)                              |
| **R-N10** Default tour opens with "Connect a service" → Connections nav  | `defaultSteps[0]` in `js/src/web/tutorial.js`                               |
| **R-N11** Apple-style "liquid glass" tokens with reduced-transparency    | `--surface-glass-*` in `js/src/web/app.css` + `prefers-reduced-transparency` fallback |
| **R-N12** Translation parity for every new string across en / ru / zh / hi | `js/src/web/locales/*.js`, enforced by `js/tests/i18n.test.js`            |

The full atomic table, component survey, and external-research notes live under [`docs/case-studies/issue-25/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/tree/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/case-studies/issue-25). The audit cross-references are recorded in [`docs/UI-DESIGN-AUDIT.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/UI-DESIGN-AUDIT.md) (en / ru / zh / hi).

## Screenshots

### Compact (360 × 740) — bottom-nav + tutorial spotlight

The first tour step anchors a translucent spotlight on the **Connections** entry of the bottom-nav and places the dialog at the *top* of the viewport so it never covers its own anchor. Tapping the highlighted control routes straight to the per-provider Connections module.

![Mobile 360 — tutorial step 1](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/mobile-360.png?raw=true)

![Mobile 360 — tap-through to Connections](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/mobile-360-tutorial-clicked-connections.png?raw=true)

### Connections module — one card per provider

![Mobile 360 — Connections list](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/mobile-360-connections.png?raw=true)

### Medium (768 × 1024) — navigation rail

![Tablet 768 — Connections with side rail](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/tablet-768-connections.png?raw=true)

### Expanded (1280 × 800) — permanent drawer + provider detail

![Desktop 1280 — Connections list](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/desktop-1280-connections.png?raw=true)

![Desktop 1280 — Email setup detail](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-25-dac43a780b5c/docs/screenshots/issue-25/desktop-1280-connection-detail.png?raw=true)

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test` — 313 tests across 81 suites pass (was 312; this PR adds an SSR test for `<TutorialSpotlight>`, a regression test for the spotlight click pass-through CSS, and `setupSteps[]` translation parity).
- [x] `npm run lint` — clean.
- [x] `npm run format:check` — clean.
- [x] `npm run check:duplication` — clean.
- [x] `npm run build:web` — produces `js/src/web/app.min.js` (≈ 620 KB).
- [x] Real-browser smoke at 360 / 768 / 1280 px via Playwright MCP — bottom-nav at ≤640 px, navigation rail at 641-1023 px, permanent drawer at ≥1024 px, tutorial spotlight click-through verified.
- [x] Glass surfaces fall back to a solid color under `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce` (covered by `js/tests/glass.test.js`).
- [x] i18n parity — `js/tests/i18n.test.js` enforces every new key exists in `en` / `ru` / `zh` / `hi`.

## Reproducer for the spotlight click pass-through bug fixed in this PR

This PR also fixes a bug discovered while taking the screenshots above: the previous tutorial overlay (`.tutorial-overlay-spotlight`) was a full-viewport `position: fixed` element whose dialog card was anchored to `flex-end`, so on mobile it visually covered the bottom-nav and intercepted every tap on the very control the spotlight was asking the user to tap. The fix lifts the target rect into the overlay component, sets `pointer-events: none` on the container with `auto` restored on the dialog card, and flips the dialog to `align-items: flex-start` (`data-spotlight-side="top"`) when the spotlight target sits in the lower half of the viewport.

## Changeset

`.changeset/issue-25-mobile-first-glass.md` (`'meta-sovereign': minor`).

commits.messageBody:
… translated copy (issue #25)

Issue #25 reported that the Russian SPA still rendered English copy like
"Your unified inbox starts empty." in the connection-guide empty
states. Root cause: <ConnectionGuide>, <ProviderCard>, <LocalServerHelp>
and Settings → Connections rendered registry literals (provider.label,
guide.title, archive.hint, …) directly, bypassing the i18n t() lookup.

Fix:
  - Add titleKey/bodyKey/labelKey/hintKey/headingKey reference fields
    to every entry in connectionGuides (14 sections), providerCatalogue
    (13 providers), and localServerHelp. Existing English literals are
    preserved so the registry-level unit tests keep working.
  - Add a tiny tx(t, value, key) helper in connection-guide.js and
    settings-view.js that prefers t(key) and falls back to the literal.
  - Replace hardcoded "Files: " / "Env var: " prefixes with
    t('guide.filesLabel', { hint }) / t('guide.envVarLabel', { name })
    so the labels themselves get translated, not just the values.
  - Mirror the new keys into ru / zh / hi dictionaries.
  - Add an i18n.test guard that fails if any non-en dictionary mirrors
    an English value verbatim (with an allow-list for brand names,
    file globs, and provider field labels that are HTTP/env names).
  - New tests: js/tests/connection-guide-i18n.test.js renders
    <ConnectionGuide section="chat"> inside ru / zh / hi LocaleContexts
    and asserts the translated copy is visible AND the English literal
    does NOT leak into the rendered markup.
commits.messageHeadline: feat(i18n): route connection guides through t() so non-en builds show…

commits.messageBody:
…rail / permanent-drawer (issue #25 R-N1, R-N2, R-N5, R-N11)

Adds js/src/web/shell/app-shell.js which classifies the current
viewport into one of three Material 3 buckets and renders the matching
primary-nav surface:

  * compact   ≤ 640 px → bottom-nav (thumb-reach, 56 × 56 px tap
                         targets, respects safe-area-inset-bottom).
  * medium    641-1023 → 80 px navigation rail.
  * expanded  ≥ 1024  → 256 px permanent left drawer.

The shell wraps the existing <main> so view modules and the dom.js
contract stay unchanged. The legacy header <nav> is hidden so the
layout switch happens in CSS rather than via runtime branches.

Also:
  * adds a new `connections` nav-items entry (R-N5) plus a matching
    `connections` connection-guide and translations in all four
    locales — the dedicated screen content + grid will land in a
    follow-up commit (Commit 3).
  * introduces a `.glass` token class with a backdrop-filter blur
    surface and a `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce` fallback
    (R-N11) used by topbar / bottom-nav / rail / drawer.
  * marks the active nav button with `aria-current="page"` and
    annotates every entry with `data-tutorial-id="nav:<id>"` so the
    upcoming TutorialSpotlight can anchor to it.

Tests:
  * new `js/tests/web-shell.test.js` (7 tests) renders the shell at
    320 / 768 / 1280 px and asserts the right surface class plus the
    Connections entry plus the glass token plus aria-current behaviour.
  * adds the missing `nav.connections`, `shell.primaryNavAria`,
    `guide.connections.title` and `guide.connections.body` keys to
    en / ru / zh / hi dictionaries (parity test still passes).

303 of 303 JS tests pass; bundle build is green.

commits.messageBody:
…d translated state badges (issue #25 R-N4..R-N8)

* New `js/src/web/connections/index.js` exports `ConnectionsList`,
  `ConnectionDetail`, and the pure `classifyConnectionState(status,
  providerId)` helper. Cards mark up `data-provider-id` plus
  `data-tutorial-id="connections:<id>"` so the upcoming
  TutorialSpotlight can anchor to them.
* New `js/src/web/connections/setup-steps.js` declares an obtain →
  enter → verify sequence per provider (13 entries — every member
  of `providerCatalogue` including `habr-career`).
* All 3 setup steps for all 13 providers ship translated
  title/body keys in en/ru/zh/hi (`connections.<id>.setup.stepN.{title,body}`).
* `views.js` ConnectionsView now threads `savedSecretIds` derived
  from `api.links()` into the new module so each card classifies
  itself as connected / not-connected / action-required.
* `js/tests/connections-screens.test.js` (4 cases) pins the
  classifier rules, asserts every provider renders a card with a
  translated state badge, asserts ConnectionDetail shows
  setupSteps[] in zh, and asserts every catalogued provider
  declares at least one step.
* `experiments/inject-setup-step-keys.mjs` is the idempotent
  generator that produced the 78 new locale keys × 4 locales.

307/307 unit tests pass; web bundle rebuilt.
commits.messageHeadline: feat(connections): per-provider Connections module with setupSteps an…

commits.messageBody:
…pener (issue #25 R-N9, R-N10)

* `TutorialSpotlight` accepts a `{top,left,width,height}` rect and
  renders a transparent frame whose `box-shadow` dims everything
  outside it, so the highlighted control reads as the only lit
  thing on screen.
* `useTutorialRect(tutorialId)` reads `[data-tutorial-id]` from the
  document and re-reads on resize/scroll via requestAnimationFrame,
  with safe fallbacks when DOM/RAF are unavailable.
* `TutorialOverlay` switches to spotlight mode when the active
  step has `tutorialId`, dropping the centred backdrop and
  rendering the anchored frame instead.
* `defaultSteps` now opens with a translated "Connect a service"
  step pointing at `nav:connections` — newcomers see exactly
  which control to tap before anything else.
* Added `tutorial.connect.title` / `tutorial.connect.body` keys
  to en/ru/zh/hi (parity test green).
* `tutorial-overlay-spotlight` CSS uses an outer box-shadow trick
  for dimming and ships a `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce`
  fallback that increases opacity instead of relying on layered
  translucency.
* New tests in `js/tests/tutorial-spotlight.test.js` (5 cases)
  pin: defaultSteps[0] is `connect`/`nav:connections`, spotlight
  markup is anchored to the supplied rect, the component is a
  no-op without a rect, and translated copy reaches all locales.
* Existing `tutorial.test.js` "Step 4 of 5" assertion is now
  derived from `defaultSteps.length` so the list can grow without
  fragile hard-coded indices.

312/312 unit tests pass, lint clean, web bundle rebuilt.

commits.messageBody:
…l (issue #25 R-N9, R-N10)

While taking PR screenshots at 360 px viewport I noticed the tutorial
spotlight was telling the user to tap "Connections" but the click never
landed: the fixed-position .tutorial-overlay-spotlight div sat on top of
the bottom-nav and swallowed every tap, and even after dropping its
pointer-events the dialog card itself was still anchored at flex-end and
visually covered its own anchor.

Fix lifts the target rect into the overlay so the dialog can be placed
opposite the spotlighted control: when the target sits in the lower half
of the viewport (mobile bottom-nav), data-spotlight-side="top" flips the
overlay to align-items: flex-start. The overlay container also drops
pointer-events: none / auto so taps on the highlighted control reach it
while the dialog buttons stay clickable.

Adds a regression test that asserts the overlay CSS declares both
pointer-events rules and the side-flip selector.
